scenario.name: reading-list
scenario.description: 12works sample: Reading list with status, rating, and per-book quotes (enum + array-of-objects), with a concept-scoped ui.frame.mode=minimal override.

notes: 12works sample, built to exercise: Reading list with status, rating, and per-book quotes (enum + array-of-objects). Note: ui.frame.mode=minimal was dropped from this sample's design -- it hides the entire #apiKey auth header by design, which makes a single-concept app unreachable on first load; minimal/none modes need a second full-mode concept (or pre-seeded auth) to be safely demonstrable, which is out of scope here.
